description: Search text content by regular expression inside the invoking run's leased worktree under descriptor-owned file, byte, deadline, and line-memory ceilings, or explicitly select fuzzy path mode. Incomplete content scans report exact counters and truncation reasons.

query.description: Regular expression in content mode or fuzzy path query in path mode.

path.description: Directory or file path relative to the leased worktree. Defaults to the worktree root.

max_results.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 100.

case_sensitive.description: Content-mode case behavior. Defaults to smart case: uppercase queries are sensitive.
